usage: 燉蛋 (dan6 daan2) is used to refer to a dessert made by steaming sweetened eggs until smooth.
The word 燉蛋 functions as a noun, so it can be used as the subject or object in a sentence.
It often appears in food-related conversations when discussing dim sum or desserts.
You can use it with verbs like 食 (sik6, eat) or 買 (maai5, buy) to talk about eating or purchasing steamed egg custard.
